title: Fractional clique decompositions of dense partite graphs
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main theorem of R. Montgomery, "Fractional clique decompositions of dense partite graphs" (arXiv:1603.01039; Combin. Probab. Comput. 26 (2017)): for r ≥ 3, every balanced K_r-divisible r-partite graph with parts of size n in which every vertex has at least (1 − 1/(10⁶r³))n neighbours in every other part has a fractional K_r-decomposition (Theorem 1.1); and its non-partite consequence: every graph on n vertices with minimum degree at least (1 − 1/(10⁶r³))n has a fractional K_r-decomposition. The whole proof is formalized: clique counts (Proposition 3.2, Lemma 3.3), the two gadgets (Lemmas 4.2, 4.3), the splitting lemma (Lemma 4.4), the moving lemmas (Lemmas 5.2, 5.3, 5.6) and the final averaging. Not formalized: Theorem 1.2 (integral decompositions), which also needs the fractional-to-exact transfer of Barber, Kühn, Lo, Osthus and Taylor.
